title: Decisions Tracker
description: Live state of the six CDP architecture decisions on the Phase 0 deck (D-1 through D-6) — all six resolved (as of 2026-06-21): Auth0; batch orchestration -> Airflow; Juicebox replacement -> Superset; object storage -> portable bronze (Azure Blob / S3, substrate per the AWS-vs-Azure bake-off); tech scaffold -> Django; consumer_attribute scoping -> two-type classification (DAS-global vs dealer-scoped) enforced by RLS (confirmed 2026-06-21).
